candidates.title: Continuing progress toward fusion energy breakeven and gain as measured against the Lawson criteria
candidates.notes: Accessible arXiv HTML review paper. Confirmed to contain NIF ignition Q data: Qsci=1.5 for Dec 5, 2022 shot (N221204), and up to Qsci=4.13 by early 2025. Provides tabular and graphical data on all NIF ignition results. Not the original Kritcher et al. paper but provides comprehensive Q value confirmation and cross-facility context.

summary.notes: G-6 and G-12 both closed by Anklam LIFE cost report (OSTI-1022881) which covers capital and O&M costs for all LIFE subsystems. G-15 closed by LLNL-TR-652984 tritium breeding blanket report. G-14 partially closed via arXiv Lawson criteria review (2505.03834) which confirms NIF ignition Q values including Dec 2022 shot; original Kritcher et al. Nature paper remains paywalled. Gaps G-8 (thermal efficiency) and G-13 (modular architecture) were not attempted due to budget limits — both are likely addressable from the Anklam report content.
